title: Recover from interrupted storage writes
description: Handle interrupted writes and storage or quota failures with bounded structured explanations while preserving last-known-good records and the user's in-memory authoring state.
acceptanceCriteria: Interrupted transactions, quota exhaustion, unavailable storage, and serialization failures return distinct recoverable results
Failed writes leave the prior committed record and related indexes/references intact
The UI retains unsaved in-memory work, identifies affected work, and offers retry, export, or discard actions where safe
Retries are bounded and no failed save is reported as durable
Failure and recovery controls are announced and keyboard operable

steps.details: Map transaction abort, quota, unavailable database, serialization, and unexpected write errors to stable results and safe corrective actions.
Keep related writes in one transaction and update durability markers only after the transaction completes successfully.
Retain the failed draft in memory and present contextual retry, backup/export, or discard choices without destructive defaults.
Abort writes at bounded transaction points and simulate quota/unavailable storage to compare committed pre-state and status outcomes.
Exercise keyboard recovery, focus restoration, announcement deduplication, bounded retry, and absence of false saved status.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; inject failures into one representative repository transaction.
Do not clear an in-memory draft merely because its persistence attempt failed.
